item.tib: khro bo stag la me 'bar bdag rdzogs kyi 'dzab sgron man ngag gnad kyi them yig
item.coloph: 'di 'dra'i thabs mchog dngos grub lam/ stag la me 'bar gyis (gyi) thugs bcud/ lha klu mi gsum dngos grub 'di/ snang mdog bdag la snyan du brgyad/ dbal chen thugs kyi bdag rdzogs la/ 'di bas dmar ba yod re kan/ 'jig rten sgya ma'i snang yul las/ gces pa'i bu dang dmar ba'i gser/ de dag pas kyang mtshang re bri/ ces dran pa nam mkha' la gdams pa'o/ 'di ni sgrub pa'i dus su gal che/ rang bzhin rgyun du bsnyen na gzhung gi chog u ya aMtham//
